Subject: ACE enrollment prep: listing checklist and next steps

John —

Great to meet you yesterday. As discussed, we want to get StitchPoint into the AWS ACE program and listed on the marketplace. To keep things moving I attached a one-page listing-eligibility checklist and a first-draft mutual action plan (MOP).

High level asks from our side:
- Confirm billing contact and marketplace account owner (legal/procurement contact).
- Identify a PDM/PSM counterpart we can introduce to AWS and include in ACE intake.
- Confirm a small technical review window (30–45m) next week so our infra team can validate the integration approach.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm contacts and sign off on the attached checklist.
2) We intro your PDM/PSM to Karthik and Naomi for ACE intake and listing requirements.
3) Technical review and a short copy-review for the marketplace listing copy.

Attachments: listing-eligibility-checklist.xlsx (attached), stitchpoint-mop-draft.pdf (attached)

If you prefer, I can loop in our AWS partner lead (Karthik) directly to speed the ACE registration.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
